Five fictional businesses. Five complete, working demos. Explore a design, then choose it as the starting point for your own website.

Every design is available with either website size. One page starts at €950; up to five pages cost €1,650.

And the ongoing costs?

Hosting, your domain and any booking service are paid separately to their providers. The accounts stay in your name. We don’t require a maintenance plan.

AN EXISTING SITE OR A SMALL CHANGE?

A price for
your next step.

Maybe you need an extra page, a new section, or a change to a site you already have. Describe it and we’ll give you a price for that piece of work before anything starts.

We focus on small business websites. Online shops, customer accounts and custom systems are outside this offer.

03 / MEET THE STUDIO

Built by people.
For your people.

You’ll talk to the people
who actually make your site.

We’re Sævar Breki Snorrason and Emil Daniel Welling. Two friends with Icelandic roots, making websites for independent Amsterdam businesses.

We’ll ask about your business before talking about your website. Then we’ll agree on something useful, make it carefully, and leave you with the files. If you need a change later, you can come back to the same two people. We’ll price it before we start.
